body: I just downloaded this app and was excited for it until, less than a minute into using it, a 1 minute ad popped up. You could at least give me 5 second ads until I’ve had a chance to use it!

title: Pay to Write To-Do List
body: This app wants you to pay them money to type your to-do list into your phone. It just gives reminders like reminder app in the phone. 😅
author: Katherina M23

title: Not Routinery!
body:
Very confusing. I should have looked at the reviews, since there are only 3. But it was recommended on a video, so I didn’t. I even paid for a month because it has such intrusive ads! Now I would like a refund.
It was similar enough to the other app that it was only when I clicked through a direct link to the app that I realized my mistake!
author: obsidity

title: Routinery - great app for habit tracking
body: I really like the way you show all the activities in a week view page which gives me the 💡 ideas of what I need to do next to meet my goal. The challenges are interesting to pick and share my friends. One thing could be improved is to integrate some activities with Pomodoro feature so that I could measure the time I spend for them. Overall this App is great for habits making and tracking which I will recommend for my friends as well. Hope you continue this good work.
author: Sky909

title: A lovely App to manage my week activities
body: As its name, this App really helpful in planning your whole week activities. Not only interface is clear, simple and easy to use, its Pomodoro tools also is great to help us to improve productivity. Really worth to try it.
